title: Orbit setup texts
description: Every string `orbit setup` writes into an assistant's files: the managed instruction block, the two hook nudges, and the values filling {{name}} placeholders in assistant templates. Read by crates/orbit-cli/src/commands/setup/spec.rs.

instructions.description: Markdown spliced into each assistant's instruction file between the orbit:setup markers.

remote.description: Values for {{name}} placeholders in `instructions`, filled when Orbit can reach GitLab at setup time and left empty otherwise.

nudge_search.description: Context the hook guard returns for a search tool call.

template_vars.description: Values substituted for {{name}} placeholders in the templates assistants declare. They reach a shell echo, so they must not contain quotes, backticks, or $(.

nudge_gitlab.description: PreToolUse nudge for glab calls when Orbit reaches GitLab; `{{orbit}}` is the launcher.

providers.description: Optional descriptions for the provider block at the end of the instructions, keyed by provider name such as `code` or `gitlab`. Entities are never listed here: `code` lists the local ontology entities grep can search, and other providers list what their server or definitions report, so the block cannot go stale. A provider without an entry is listed without a description.

description.description: Shown in parentheses after the provider's name, such as `code (local code)`.
